create_octree_voxel: create a DfsOctree instance with voxel primitives for sparse 3D scene representation
create_octree_gaussian: create a DfsOctree instance with gaussian primitives for 3D Gaussian splatting
create_octree_trivec: create a DfsOctree instance with trivec primitives for 3D scene representation
subdivide_octree_nodes: subdivide octree leaf nodes by passing a mask with value 1 to structure_control
merge_octree_nodes: merge octree leaf nodes into parents by passing a mask with value -1 to structure_control
